scope: Raw direct-visual working notes only. These are not inspection records, receipts, suitability assessments, or disposition decisions.
verification_method: For every record, sha256sum of the checked-out canonical path matched frozen_sha256 in the named batch inspection-source-manifest.json before view_image inspection.
